obligations.behavior: Compute RFC 1071 ones'-complement checksums across DATA_WIDTH in {64, 256} with even/odd/multi-beat csum_start, split-beat csum_offset, USE_INIT_VALUE, passthrough mode, and lossless 1-to-1 packet/checksum alignment under csum_fifo backpressure.
Compute RX ones'-complement packet sums across arbitrary START_OFFSET >= 2*KEEP_WIDTH and short frames, and synchronously reset all control/accumulator state for Zero-X ASIC gate-level parity.
Close Nangate45 OpenSTA timing at clk = 1.20ns (WNS >= 0, TNS >= 0, hold >= 0) with mapped cell area <= 1,150 um^2 on rx_checksum and <= 6,300 um^2 on tx_checksum.
